import re, time, urllib.request

def run(**kwargs):
    url = kwargs.get("url")
    if not url:
        return "ERROR: url required"
    out_dir = kwargs.get("out_dir", "missions/payment.duskyr.com/extractions")
    max_results = int(kwargs.get("max_results", 200))
    ctx = int(kwargs.get("context", 60))
    req = urllib.request.Request(url)
    body = urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=40).read().decode("utf-8", "ignore")
    pats = [
        r"/api/[A-Za-z0-9_\-/\.\$\{\}]+",
        r"fetch\([^)]{0,120}",
        r"[\"'](GET|POST|PUT|DELETE)[\"'],\s*[\"'][^\"']{2,60}[\"']",
        r"method:\s*[\"'](GET|POST|PUT|DELETE)[\"']",
    ]
    seen = set()
    lines = []
    for pat in pats:
        for m in re.finditer(pat, body):
            s = m.group(0)
            if s in seen:
                continue
            seen.add(s)
            start = max(0, m.start() - ctx)
            end = min(len(body), m.end() + ctx)
            snippet = body[start:end].replace("\n", " ")
            lines.append(f"@{m.start()}: {s} ||| {snippet}")
    fname = f"{out_dir}/tailgrep_{int(time.time())}.txt"
    try:
        import os
        os.makedirs(out_dir, exist_ok=True)
        with open(fname, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            f.write(f"url={url} body_len={len(body)} matches={len(lines)}\n")
            f.write("\n".join(lines[:max_results]))
        saved = fname
    except Exception as e:
        saved = f"(write failed: {e})"
    head = "\n".join(lines[:12])
    return f"body_len={len(body)} matches={len(lines)} saved={saved}\nHEAD:\n{head}"
